text:
𝗚𝗥𝗘𝗘𝗡 𝗛𝗔𝗚𝗟𝗘𝗬! 🌱🏏

Morkel calls the pitch "very green"; rain kept it covered Thursday. India have won 9 of 11 tosses on tour.

Latham: "Odds stacking in our favour." Who bowls first? 👇
